stem: In which city of Bihar was the recently inaugurated National Dolphin Research Centre located ?
expl: On 4 March, 2024, the Chief Minister of Bihar, Nitish Kumar, inaugurated the National Dolphin Research Centre. This centre is located in Patna.

stem: Who has been awarded with the Dadasaheb Phalke Indian Television Award in 2022 from Bihar?

stem: In which state is 'Raksha Bandhan' celebrated as 'Tree Protection Day'?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: In the state of Bihar, the day of ‘Raksha Bandhan’ is celebrated as ‘Tree Protection Day’ by the Bihar Government. This initiative was started by the Chief Minister of Bihar, Nitish Kumar.

stem: In April, 2020 the Bihar Education Department started the following program through DD Bihar

stem: In which district of Bihar was the first floating solar power plant built?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The first floating solar power plant in Bihar has been built in Darbhanga district. This solar plant has been built on a pond in Kadirabad in Darbhanga district, with a capacity of 2 megawatts.

stem: Which of the following centres in Bihar is proposed to be developed under Vishnupad Yojana for promotion of tourism in Union Budget 2024 ?
expl: In the Union Budget 2024–25 presented in July, 2024, following the model of the Kashi Vishwanath Temple Corridor, extensive development was proposed for the Vishnupad Temple Corridor in Gaya and the Mahabodhi Temple Corridor in Bodh Gaya to transform them into world-class pilgrimage and tourist destinations.

stem: Bihula Festival is especially celebrated every year in the month of August in which of the following districts of Bihar?
expl: The Bihula Festival is especially celebrated every year in August in Bhagalpur district of Bihar. In this festival of eastern Bihar, people pray to Goddess Manasa for the welfare of their families.

stem: Which of the following has received a GI tag in Bihar?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Among the given options, Magahi Paan has received the GI tag. Magahi Paan is an expensive variety of betel leaf, cultivated in the Magadh region of Bihar, in districts such as Aurangabad, Gaya, Nalanda, etc.

stem: Who has been appointed by the Government of Bihar as the Chairman of the State Backward Classes Commission on January 2, 2022?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Justice Sanjay Kumar was appointed as the Chairman of the State Backward Classes Commission by the Government of Bihar on 2 January 2022. He assumed charge on 5 January 2022.

stem: Who was the Chief Justice of the Patna High Court who administered the oath of office to Shri Phagu Chauhan as the Governor of Bihar in July 2019?

stem: Which airport did the NDMA conduct a mock drill based on CBRN emergency in April, 2018?

options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

stem: When was the Lok Sabha Election 2004 cancelled and re-voting done at Chhapra constituency in Bihar?

stem: In which Indian state is 'Kala-azar' disease widespread?

stem: Which of the following individuals from Bihar has been awarded the Bharat Ratna?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: In the context of the time of the question, option (a) was the correct answer. Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the first President of India, was honoured with India’s highest civilian award, the Bharat Ratna, in 1962. It is noteworthy that Dr. Rajendra Prasad was born on 3 December, 1884, in Ziradei village of Siwan district (then Saran) of Bihar. People affectionately called him “Rajendra Babu”. His father’s name was Mahadev Sahai and his mother’s name was Kamleshwari Devi. In 2024, former Chief Minister of Bihar Karpoori Thakur was also awarded the Bharat Ratna. Therefore, in the present context, option (e) will be the correct answer.

stem: When was the first integrated check post established in Bihar?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The first Integrated Check Post in Bihar was established on 7 April, 2018. This Integrated Check Post at Birgunj (Raxaul–Birgunj) was jointly inaugurated by the Prime Ministers of India and Nepal on 7 April, 2018, whereas the Biratnagar (Jogbani–Biratnagar) Integrated Check Post was inaugurated on 21 January, 2020.

stem: Which state government has recently completely banned the manufacturing, sale, and purchase of electronic cigarettes in the entire state?

stem: Which of the following states launched the 'Safe City Surveillance Scheme' in December, 2017 to curb crimes against women in public places?
